en.quote: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel.
en.riddle: The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel.
en.speaker: God

he.quote: וְעֵינֵיכֶם תִּרְאֶינָה וְאַתֶּם תֹּֽאמְרוּ יִגְדַּל יְהוָה מֵעַל לִגְבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
he.speaker: אלוהים

en.5: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel.
